description: This file defines a React server component for the 'Integrations' page in a web application. It fetches data such as connectors and connections from an API, processes this data, and renders a client component for interactivity along with some static UI elements.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: An async function that concurrently fetches connectors and connections data, processes the connections into a lookup object by connector ID, and returns these structured data objects for rendering.

methods.name: IntegrationsPage
methods.description: An async React server component that uses getData() to fetch data and renders the Integrations page with static and dynamic content, including the IntegrationsClient component.
